title: Week 6 · Same anchors, new tricks
notes: Functional Bodybuilding week 6: anchors held or nudged by double progression from the 8 Nov export (no newer log seen); accessories set B, formats, kettlebell moves and runs all new vs week 5. Strides replace hills, a progression run replaces fartlek. No appointments 16–22 Nov.

sa-db-bench.u: Bench press with one dumbbell; the trunk resists twisting.
s: Lie on the bench, one dumbbell over your shoulder.
Free hand on your ribs, feet planted wide.
Lower slowly to chest level, elbow about 45°.
Press up, breathing out, hips stay level.
c: Squeeze the bench with your back
sa-db-bench.m: Twisting off the bench as the weight comes down.
sa-db-bench.z: Breathe out on every press; never hold your breath.

incline-rear-fly.q: incline bench rear delt fly dumbbell
incline-rear-fly.u: Chest on an incline bench, light dumbbells, arms open wide.
s: Set the bench to about 30°, chest on the pad.
Head up in line, arms hanging, small bend at elbows.
Open the arms out wide, thumbs forward.
Pause, lower slowly, breathe out as you lift.
incline-rear-fly.m: Shrugging or swinging the weights up.
incline-rear-fly.z: Chest stays supported and head up; breathe out on each lift.

cossack-squat.u: Side-to-side squat holding the rack for balance.
s: Stand wide, toes slightly out, hold the rack.
Sit into one hip, other leg straight.
Go only as deep as feels easy.
Push back to the middle, breathing out.
c: Heel of the bent leg down
cossack-squat.m: Forcing depth so the heel lifts.
cossack-squat.z: Small range is fine; no forcing, keep breathing.

tib-raise.u: Back on a wall, lift your toes to strengthen the shins.
s: Lean your back on a wall, feet a step out.
Legs straight, lift your toes as high as you can.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Breathe out as you lift.
tib-raise.z: Easy on the shins; stop if it cramps.

Kettlebell pullover.u: Lying flat on the bench, lower the bell behind your head and pull it back.
s: Lie flat on the bench, head supported.
Hold the bell by the horns over your chest.
Lower it back behind your head, ribs down.
Pull it back over your chest, breathing out.
c: Only go as far as is comfortable
Kettlebell pullover.m: Arching the lower back as the bell goes back.
Kettlebell pullover.z: Head stays on the bench; breathe out as you pull.

Front-rack reverse lunge.u: Reverse lunge with the bell held in the rack on one side.
s: Clean the bell to the rack, elbow down.
Step back into a lunge, back knee towards the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
Breathe out as you stand up.
c: Use a light touch on the rack if needed
Front-rack reverse lunge.z: Breathe out on the way up; no breath holding.
